summary: Scans the input string a1 from its start and counts the leading run of ASCII letters before the first non-letter character, returning that count. Each iteration reads the next character, increments the counter, and breaks when the character is outside both the A-Z range (65..90) and the a-z range (97..122).

local_names.v3: current character read from the string
local_names.result: running count of leading alphabetical characters

operations.description: Iterate over the characters of a1 from the start, reading one character into v3 and advancing the pointer each iteration.
Break the loop when the current character v3 is outside both ASCII ranges A-Z (65..90) and a-z (97..122), ending the count at the first non-letter.
Increment result once per alphabetical character consumed before the break.
Return result, the number of leading alphabetical characters in a1.
